module.purpose: Provides a server-side cache invalidation operation for organization and team role changes, ensuring affected role, permission, membership, and feature data is refreshed across relevant settings and team pages.
module.summary: This Next.js server module centralizes cache revalidation for role-related settings. It refreshes the organization roles page, dynamic team role pages, shared cache tags, and team-specific tags covering roles, permissions, members, and features.
module.businessContext:
Supports organization administration and team access-control management.
If invalidation fails, role and permission changes may not appear promptly, causing stale access information.
functions: revalidateTeamRoles (~L5-22): Invalidates organization, team, permission, membership, and feature caches after role changes.

io: Invalidates the organization roles path and dynamic team roles page through revalidatePath.
Invalidates shared and team-specific cache tags through revalidateTag.

sectionMap.name: revalidateTeamRoles
sectionMap.intent: Invalidates role pages and shared and team-specific cache tags.

edgeCases.inputShape: Malformed runtime teamId value that is not a number
edgeCases.behavior: The value is interpolated directly into team-specific cache tag strings without validation.
The numeric value is interpolated into each team-specific cache tag.

assumptions.description: The caller supplies a numeric teamId identifying the team whose role-related tags should be invalidated.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When team role revalidation runs for any team, the organization roles path and dynamic team roles page path are revalidated.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins both static and dynamic route cache invalidation.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When team role revalidation runs, all shared role and permission cache tags are invalidated.
moduleContractTests.then: revalidateTag("team-roles"), revalidateTag("resource-permissions"), and revalidateTag("team-feature") are each called once
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards invalidation of shared role-related cache entries.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When revalidation runs for a specific team, all team-scoped cache tags use that team's identifier.
moduleContractTests.then: revalidateTag("team-roles-42"), revalidateTag("resource-permissions-42"), revalidateTag("team-members-42"), and revalidateTag("team-features-42") are each called once
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins correct interpolation of the team identifier into every scoped cache tag.

units.name: revalidateTeamRoles

detail.name: revalidateTeamRoles
postconditions: The organization roles path is requested for revalidation.
The dynamic team roles page path is requested for revalidation.
The shared and team-specific role, permission, feature, and membership cache tags are requested for invalidation.
The function resolves with undefined if all revalidation calls succeed.
invariants: The shared organization and team roles path revalidations are always issued.
All three shared cache tags are invalidated.
All four team-specific cache tags are constructed using the supplied teamId.
edgeCases: A numeric teamId, including zero or a negative number, is interpolated directly into each team-specific cache tag.
If a revalidation dependency throws or rejects, the asynchronous function rejects and later revalidation calls are not guaranteed to execute.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation is performed; the supplied value is interpolated into team-specific tag strings.

stateMutations: Next.js cache-tag invalidation state for shared and team-specific tags.
detail.summary: Invalidates the organization roles, team roles, and related team-specific cache entries for a team. The operation completes without a return value after issuing all configured revalidation requests.

Dynamic team roles page path submitted for revalidation.

Shared team-roles cache tag invalidated by the function.
Shared resource-permissions cache tag invalidated by the function.
Shared team-feature cache tag invalidated by the function.
Team-specific team-roles cache tag constructed from teamId.
Team-specific resource-permissions cache tag constructed from teamId.
Team-specific team-members cache tag constructed from teamId.
Team-specific team-features cache tag constructed from teamId.

specTests.then: revalidation is requested for /settings/organizations/roles and /settings/teams/[id]/roles with type page, and the invalidated tags are team-roles, resource-permissions, team-feature, team-roles-42, resource-permissions-42, team-members-42, and team-features-42.
